item.title: CVE-2026-124003 — Unknown Vendor XWEB EVO before CVSS 7.8 High Severity Vulnerability
item.description: Score 64/100 MEDIUM — CVSS 7.8 — XWEB EVO before 5.6.2 contains a command injection vulnerability where the setuid-root Lua CGI interpreter wlua executes system("/usr/bin/lua "+argv) on unsanitized input. item.title: pgEdge Control Plane generates pg_hba.conf with trust authentication for local and loopback connections
item.description: Score 62/100 MEDIUM — CVSS 7.8 — ### Summary Every `pg_hba.conf` generated by the pgEdge Control Plane begins with a hard-coded block of `trust` entries covering Unix-socket and loopback connections. Any operating-system account that can reach the Postgres socket or the loopback interface on a database host can authenticate as any .
